## Summary

Acmetech Cloud provides developer-focused cloud tooling that helps engineering teams ship
faster with less operational overhead. We are a synthetic JD fixture used to test the resume

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer who thrives at the intersection of polished
user experience and resilient backend systems. You will own complete product verticals, work
alongside a small cross-functional team, and have direct influence over the technical
direction of our core product.

## Responsibilities

- Architect, build, and ship full-stack features spanning React frontend and Node.js backend
- Design and evolve PostgreSQL schemas with a focus on performance, integrity, and simplicity
- Define and maintain API contracts between frontend clients and backend services
- Collaborate with design to translate Figma prototypes into production-quality UI components
- Build and maintain infrastructure automation for staging and production environments on AWS
- Drive observability improvements including structured logging, metrics, and alerting
- Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident resolution for product-critical services
- Mentor teammates through code reviews and contribute to engineering culture and processes

## Required Skills

- 5+ years of professional software engineering with fullstack ownership of production systems
- Strong TypeScript proficiency across both browser and Node.js runtime environments
- Expertise in React including hooks, state management patterns, and performance optimization
- Experience designing and operating PostgreSQL databases at non-trivial scale
- Hands-on AWS experience including EC2, RDS, S3, and managed container orchestration
- Comfort with Node.js backend patterns including REST API design and background job processing
- Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines including GitHub Actions or equivalent tooling
- Experience with frontend testing strategies using Jest, Playwright, or Cypress
- Strong debugging skills across the full stack including network, browser, and server layers
- Excellent written communication for async-first distributed team collaboration

## Preferred

- Experience building developer tools, internal platforms, or infrastructure-facing products
- Familiarity with edge runtimes, CDN configuration, or serverless compute patterns
- Contributions to open-source TypeScript or JavaScript projects
- Background in performance profiling and optimization at frontend or database layer

## Compensation

$160,000 – $220,000 base salary (USD equivalent, location-adjusted) + equity + benefits

We offer competitive equity grants, flexible PTO, home office stipend, health benefits for
US employees, and a remote-first culture with no core hours. We operate across time zones and
use thoughtful async communication to stay coordinated without excessive meetings.

## About Acmetech Cloud

Acmetech Cloud was born out of frustration with the operational complexity of modern cloud
infrastructure. We believe developer platforms should be opinionated, composable, and easy to
reason about. Our customers are engineering teams at growth-stage startups and mid-market
companies who need reliable tooling without building it themselves.

We are a small, senior team that moves quickly and writes code we are proud of. You will have
real ownership and real impact from your first week. We do not have a QA team — engineers own
quality end-to-end, and we think that makes for better engineers and better products.

Acmetech Cloud is an equal-opportunity employer. We actively recruit across geographies and
backgrounds and are committed to building a globally inclusive team.

## Interview Process

1. Recruiter screen — 30-minute intro call to discuss your background and expectations
2. Technical assessment — async take-home covering fullstack architecture and TypeScript
3. Engineering interview — 60-minute review of the take-home with two senior engineers
4. System design — 60-minute session designing a real component of our product
5. Founders chat — 30-minute conversation about culture, vision, and long-term fit

We value your time. Our process is designed to reach a decision within two weeks from first
contact. We provide detailed feedback to all candidates who complete the technical rounds,
regardless of outcome.
